responsive.rationale: No DOM of its own; consumers own layout.

sharedContract.upstream: https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york-v4/chart-<name>.json — ported by tooling/upstream/pull.mjs with one import rewrite, recorded in vendor/shadcn/4.21.0/manifest.json under `ported`.

ref.rationale: A chart block is a copy-once Card composition; it forwards no ref and has no prop surface.

variants.rationale: The family name IS the variant axis (area/bar/line/pie/radar/radial/tooltip); each member is one fixed composition.

sizes.rationale: Each member fills its Card; ChartContainer owns the aspect ratio.

behavior.evidence: recharts' own tooltip and the three members that carry a Select or a header toggle.

visual.evidence: The Card chrome plus recharts' cursor and tooltip.

responsive.rationale: ChartContainer measures its own box; the gallery pages place the members in a responsive grid.

reducedMotion.rationale: The global reduced-motion reset in base.css neutralises it (MOT-5); the blocks add no motion of their own.

coverage.test: all-member browser render plus axe, in one suite
coverage.preview: one preview module per family, one fixture per member
coverage.vrt: one capture per family in the batch review artifact
